summary: The note covers the 2013 Dunedin mayoral election, held on Saturday, 12 October 2013 under the single transferable voting system. The incumbent Dave Cull, Dunedin's 57th mayor, was re-elected after defeating eight challengers.
one_line: Dave Cull was re-elected mayor of Dunedin in the October 2013 election held under single transferable voting.
key_facts: The 2013 Dunedin mayoral election was held on Saturday, 12 October 2013.
The election was conducted under the single transferable voting system.
Dave Cull was re-elected as mayor of Dunedin.
Dave Cull won re-election after seeing off eight challengers.
